title: Serialize ledger read-modify-append across writers
evidence: append_event reads the entire chain at 123, derives index/prev_hash at 125-129, then opens an independent append handle at 160-166; no lock covers that interval. CLI main.rs:227 and :474 invoke this function.
trigger: Two processes append to the same existing ledger before either write completes.
impact: Both can acknowledge blocks with the same index and predecessor; verify_chain subsequently rejects index continuity.

title: Sync committed ledger records before acknowledging success
evidence: Only writeln! precedes Ok(block); no sync_data/sync_all or transactional durable commit exists. main.rs:230 displays ATTESTATION COMMITTED.
trigger: Storage or host failure after append_event returns but before OS cache reaches durable media.
impact: An acknowledged attestation can disappear or leave a partial final JSON line, preventing subsequent chain reads.

title: Export the actual block hash algorithm
evidence: append_event computes block_hash with BLAKE3 at 145; export_scitt_voucher unconditionally labels leaf_hash_algorithm SHA-256 at 273. main.rs:241 exports that voucher.
trigger: A newly appended block is requested using the SCITT output format.
impact: An independent consumer applying the declared hash algorithm cannot reproduce the advertised leaf commitment.

title: SIGTERM seals the ledger without terminating the intercepted child
evidence: Signals only set shutdown_flag (181-182); the wait loop exits on it, seals, and returns (237-253). No kill or wait follows a signal.
trigger: Send SIGTERM/SIGINT while the spawned real CLI is still running.
impact: The wrapper exits and reports closure while its child can continue running and modifying files outside the monitoring lifetime.

title: Persistence failures are discarded while closure is reported successful
evidence: FS_EVENT inserts discard Result at 211; CLOSURE_SEAL insert discards Result at 248 followed by unconditional closure output at 249-250 and Ok at 253.
trigger: An insert fails, for example because another writer advanced the head (122-123), disk is full, or SQLite rejects the write.
impact: Events or the final seal are absent despite successful process status and closure output; callers cannot distinguish audit loss.

title: Lamport allocation races across browser agent connections
evidence: _next_lamport_t lines 39-44 reads MAX(lamport_t)+1 before the separate INSERT at lines 54-60. The schema lines 13-21 has no unique constraint on lamport_t. URLCacheSync opens connect_sync; database/core.py:70 uses isolation_level=None.
trigger: Two BrowserResearchAgent instances sharing a database both read the same MAX before either inserts an attestation.
impact: Both inserts can persist the same logical tick, violating the declared Lamport ordering and leaving no deterministic per-event ordering.

title: Cache commits before the attestation and hides interrupted writes
evidence: cache.put is called at line 120 and _record_attestation only at line 125. URLCacheSync uses the autocommit connection (database/core.py:70). The cache-hit return at lines 87-95 neither checks nor repairs bft_attestations.
trigger: The process exits, or the attestation INSERT fails, after cache.put has committed and before the attestation is persisted.
impact: Subsequent calls return cached content marked passed without the promised audit record, and normal cache hits never recover that missing record.

title: Proof verifier ignores the claimed leaf index
evidence: verify_proof hashes inner_proof and peaks but never reads leaf_index or checks path orientation against its index.
trigger: Change leaf_index in a valid generated proof, keeping its path, peaks and total_leaves.
impact: Verification still returns true for a false positional membership claim; no external production consumer was established.

title: Malformed peak index panics instead of rejecting proof
evidence: other_peaks[..proof.peak_index] and [proof.peak_index..] are indexed without checking bounds.
trigger: Call public verify_proof with peak_index greater than other_peaks.len().
impact: Verifier panics on malformed input instead of returning false; exposure to remote inputs remains unverified.

title: E2E script contaminates and resets the persistent CORTEX database
evidence: DB_PATH points to repository data/cortex_memory.db (30); three simulated successful traces are inserted there (63-78), then UPDATE cortex_invariant_clusters SET status=ACCUMULATING, lean4_proof_status=UNTESTED has no WHERE (81-84). goal_trace_ingestor.py:20-21 uses the same default database and persists/increments these clusters (75-124).
trigger: Run this script in a checkout with existing CORTEX traces or proved clusters.
impact: Synthetic success records enter the persistent corpus and every existing cluster loses its verification status; subsequent extraction/code generation operates on the altered database.

title: Benchmark reports a measured fast-path latency without timing it
evidence: The final report prints constant 0.18 ms and 27,444x acceleration. The only elapsed duration captured is cargo check t_check (115-123); the fast-path subprocess is never timed.
trigger: Complete the script successfully, regardless of actual fast-path execution latency.
impact: The output presents fabricated timing and acceleration as local measurement, making benchmark evidence misleading.

title: Remove comments from multipart JSON metadata example
evidence: The curl metadata form contains "compatibility_date": "2026-01-01" followed by a // comment inside the JSON field.
trigger: Copy the Deploy with Bindings metadata example into an actual request after replacing the abbreviated URL.
impact: The metadata payload is invalid JSON, so the example cannot deploy the requested bindings. This is a static example defect, not an observed service failure.

title: Avoid redeclaring the imported DispatchNamespace name
evidence: One TypeScript block imports type DispatchNamespace and then declares interface DispatchNamespace in the same module (lines 36-40).
trigger: Use the TypeScript Types block as written in a TypeScript module.
impact: The imported type name conflicts with the local declaration, making the reference example fail type checking.

title: Codex query reports success after a failed execution with partial text
evidence: Failure is returned only when proc.returncode != 0 AND not full_text; every other path returns success True at line 169. _parse_codex_events does not propagate failed turn events.
trigger: Codex emits an agent_message then exits nonzero, for example after a later tool or turn failure.
impact: Consumers receive success True with partial output and lose the execution failure signal.

title: Purge targets its installed package and moves importable modules
evidence: PROJECT_ROOT is dirname(__file__); categorize_and_move enumerates it at line92 and moves every unprotected .py at103. __init__.py, cortex_chaos_monad.py and gemini_labs_nexus.py are not protected.
trigger: Run this module as its __main__ entrypoint in the checkout or installed package.
impact: Moves package implementation files into .cortex/archive/scripts and breaks subsequent imports; does not operate on the repository root advertised by its report.

title: Tip-of-tongue branch is mathematically unreachable
evidence: highest_score initializes to 0.5 and only increases. tip_of_tongue requires highest_score < 0.35 and a nonempty matched list; matches themselves require a score > 0.5.
trigger: Any call to judge_procedural_fok with candidates.
impact: The returned judgment can never signal tip_of_tongue, so callers cannot distinguish this intended uncertainty state. No downstream authorization consequence is claimed.

title: Ledger audit reports HEALTHY without inspecting any ledger
evidence: c5.auditLedger returns constant HEALTHY and compliance Verified JSON. No ledger path, read, hash recomputation, or BFT check occurs. main.rs:142-166 routes workspace/executeCommand directly to this function.
trigger: Invoke the advertised ledger-audit CodeAction with a missing or corrupted ledger.
impact: The editor receives a successful integrity/compliance assertion with no evidence.

title: Appliance installer copies from a crate-local target directory in a workspace
evidence: REPO_DIR resolves to crates/eridu-infer at 60-61; cargo build executes there at 68 but cp expects crates/eridu-infer/target/release/eridu-infer at 69. Cargo.toml defines the root workspace; .cargo/config.toml has no target-dir override.
trigger: Run provisioning from a clean checkout with cargo available and no crate-local prebuilt binary or CARGO_TARGET_DIR override.
impact: Cargo places the workspace artifact in root target; cp fails under set -e after system power/network settings have already been changed.

title: Reallocation clears live borrow state without invalidating references
evidence: Alloc blindly inserts Unborrowed into states; existing reference_map entries are retained.
trigger: Alloc R0; BorrowMut R1 from R0; Alloc R0; Free R0. The second Alloc erases Mut(R1), so Free returns Ok while R1 remains mapped.
impact: The example checker loses the outstanding R1 borrow and can accept Free R0 while R1 remains mapped, undermining its demonstrated lifetime guarantee.

title: Sexagesimal conversion scales integer units by sixty
evidence: from_rational uses (num * 60) // den for integer gin decomposition, while to_scalar interprets gin as units. For num=1, den=1 the fields produce u=1 and scalar=60.
trigger: Convert any ordinary rational, including from_rational(1,1), then call to_scalar.
impact: Demo receipt encodes an incorrect confidence scalar; the sample 59/60 becomes 59 rather than approximately 0.9833.

title: Bundling success claims are emitted without checking measured results
evidence: The function prints fixed SNR >15 dB / 100% recall K<=50 and >98% K=300 claims after displaying results, and the final bundling verdict is always 100% PASS. No assertions check bundling_results.
trigger: Computed bundling recall or SNR falls below the printed threshold.
impact: The demonstration reports certification and PASS despite a failed or degraded measurement.

title: Generator computes scripts directory as its output root
evidence: dirname(dirname(__file__)) from scripts/c5_isomorphisms resolves to scripts; output paths append cortex, babylon60 and docs.
trigger: Run this generator from its current repository location.
impact: It writes scripts/cortex, scripts/babylon60 and scripts/docs instead of updating canonical repository outputs.

title: Windows setup resolves scripts as repository root
evidence: The script lives in scripts/c5_setup; taking one parent of ScriptDir resolves scripts, so WorkspaceAgents is scripts/.agents. Missing source is silently skipped.
trigger: Run the checked-in setup script from its normal location.
impact: Workspace governance is not copied although final output declares successful environment preparation.

title: Verifier records unconditional PASS for properties it does not inspect
evidence: verify_four_renunciations records four literal True values without runtime inputs; verify_bayes_axiom4_disintegration records Split Epi as True solely from is_split_epi. print_report uses these rows in ALL AXIOMS SATISFIED — SYSTEM SOUND.
trigger: Invoke the verifier against its built-in fixture or invoke these methods after an implementation violates the described constraints.
impact: Report presents unchecked assertions as verification successes; the script cannot establish the advertised runtime constraints or a deterministic section identity.

title: Release verifier accepts a bundle with no manifest digest binding
evidence: When --bundle is supplied, SHA-256 comparison is conditional on truthy release_bundle metadata. Without that optional metadata the digest is computed and discarded, followed by VERIFIED. CI invokes the script with --bundle (.github/workflows/ci.yml:146).
trigger: Verify any existing bundle against otherwise valid evidence whose manifest has no release_bundle object.
impact: The verified message does not establish that the supplied bundle is the release described by the evidence.

title: Webhook example consumes request body twice
evidence: Line 29 awaits request.text() for signature verification; line 32 awaits request.text() again for JSON. Request body is single-use; MDN Request.text documents TypeError for disturbed/locked body: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Request/text
trigger: Valid signed webhook with a body using the provided handler.
impact: Second body read rejects before queueing; valid events fail rather than returning 202. Cache the first text and parse it.

title: Skill persistence reports success after failed copy
evidence: The script uses set -uo pipefail, not errexit; the copytree Python command is not checked and execution proceeds to a separate status=ok JSON emitter.
trigger: Target creation or copying fails due to permissions, disk exhaustion or a concurrent target writer.
impact: Caller receives successful exit/status although the canonical bundle is missing or only partly copied.

title: Reject path components before recursive extension deletion
evidence: main passes required --id directly to cmd_purge (lines 257-270); cmd_purge only strips whitespace/nonempty checks (158-161), joins it into directory paths (171,179), then calls shutil.rmtree (173,181).
trigger: Run purge with an absolute directory path as --id or a traversal such as ../.. while a Chrome profile exists.
impact: The locally invoked cleanup command can recursively delete a user-accessible directory outside the extension directory. This is an unsafe CLI input boundary, not a claim of remote exploitation.

title: Mutable ballistic history makes a frame depend on render order
evidence: useMemo retains one ballisticState; render calls extractBands at lines 53–55. SpectralFlux.ts updates prevSpectrum and smoothedValues in extractBands/applyBallistics.
trigger: Render the same frame after different previous frames, seek backwards, or render frames on independent workers.
impact: Onset and smoothing outputs differ for the same frame; visual output is not reproducible across seeking and render chunk boundaries.
